actions.title: Read the private evidence boundary
actions.instruction: This source-only lesson is not runnable in Preview 0.15. Its future private contract is limited to an exact refactor of workshop_queue/store.py, a later docs-only README.md commit, the generated CHANGELOG.md release commit, an unchanged pre-existing tests/test_store.py, a clean worktree, and the declared annotated academy-v0.0.1 tag at the attempt head. Do not substitute your own scope, target, or release metadata.
actions.rationale: A narrow contract makes the difference between repository evidence and a broader release claim visible.
actions.expected_result: You can name the future private boundaries and know that Preview 0.15 does not prepare this lesson.
actions.recovery: If you need a runnable exercise today, return to an available Preview 0.15 lesson. Do not create U03 state files by hand.
actions.evidence: A future Check can observe repository bytes, commit topology, the declared release target, generated CHANGELOG section, a clean worktree, and a local tag. It does not prove behavioral parity, human approval, CodeArbiter command execution, tag push, or publication.

actions.title: Ask Preview 0.15 to prepare U03
actions.instruction: At the clean Academy clone root, run Prepare in a native terminal. Native-terminal commands go directly into that terminal and never begin with !.
actions.rationale: The refusal distinguishes unavailable training material from a prepared attempt.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.15 refuses U03 as unavailable or not published and leaves the repository unchanged.
actions.recovery: Treat the refusal as the public boundary. Do not retry with another command or simulate a prepared attempt.
actions.evidence: Preview 0.15 creates no U03 attempt, scenario, commit, tag, or release record.

actions.title: Confirm the refusal changed nothing
actions.instruction: Inspect the worktree from the same native terminal after the refusal. These commands are direct terminal commands and never begin with !.
actions.rationale: An unavailable lesson must not leave partial learner state behind.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.15 refuses U03 and the worktree remains unchanged.
actions.recovery: If unrelated work is already present, preserve it and resolve that work separately. Do not hand-author a U03 scenario.
actions.evidence: An empty status output only confirms the local worktree state you inspected.

actions.title: Review the future sealed brief before work begins
actions.instruction: Only in a future private prepared attempt, read the sealed brief and identify its exact refactor scope, approved README fact, declared release target, generated CHANGELOG path, and derived annotated tag academy-v0.0.1. The brief supplies those values. Do not invent a generic command argument or a release claim.
actions.rationale: The source lesson can teach the boundary now without pretending the current public release has prepared it.
actions.expected_result: You can distinguish the prepared brief's exact values from details the lesson does not establish.
actions.recovery: If any required value is absent or ambiguous, stop the future attempt and preserve the condition for its author. Do not guess.
actions.evidence: Reading a brief does not authenticate a human approval or an executed host command.

actions.title: Start the host-native refactor route
actions.instruction: Only in a future private prepared attempt, invoke the host-native refactor route. Supply the exact sealed scope when the host asks for it. This is a CodeArbiter command, never a ! terminal passthrough command.
actions.rationale: The refactor route should be bounded by the sealed U03 surface before the learner examines a change.
actions.expected_result: In a future private attempt, the host gathers the sealed scope before producing a proposed refactor boundary.
actions.recovery: If the host requests a value that the sealed brief does not provide, stop. Do not supply a made-up scope.
actions.evidence: This lesson does not treat the command text as proof of behavioral parity or CodeArbiter command execution.

actions.title: Inspect the proposed refactor boundary
actions.instruction: Only in a future private attempt, inspect the proposed diff in a native terminal. These commands are direct terminal commands and never begin with !.
actions.rationale: The learner sees the exact implementation path before staging it.

variants.command:
git diff -- workshop_queue/store.py
git diff -- tests/test_store.py

git diff -- workshop_queue/store.py
git diff -- tests/test_store.py

git diff -- workshop_queue/store.py
git diff -- tests/test_store.py

actions.expected_result: You can inspect the proposed store.py delta and confirm that tests/test_store.py has no diff in the future private attempt.
actions.recovery: If a pre-existing test changes or another path is involved, stop the refactor boundary instead of staging it.
actions.evidence: A diff shows local bytes. It does not prove behavioral parity.

actions.title: Decide whether the refactor boundary is acceptable
actions.instruction: In a future private attempt, decide whether the proposed change is limited to the sealed refactor boundary and leaves tests/test_store.py unchanged. Do not ask the agent to widen the task or assert that a review proves parity.
actions.rationale: A learner decision remains separate from repository evidence.
actions.expected_result: You either stop the refactor boundary or can name the exact file that may be staged.
actions.recovery: If the boundary is unclear, return to the sealed brief and preserve the proposed diff. Do not stage it.
actions.evidence: No file or log can prove that this learner review occurred.

actions.title: Stage only the sealed refactor file
actions.instruction: Only after accepting the future private refactor boundary, stage workshop_queue/store.py in a native terminal. Native-terminal commands never begin with !.
actions.rationale: The staged path list makes the first commit boundary explicit.
actions.expected_result: The future private staged boundary names only workshop_queue/store.py.
actions.recovery: If another path is staged, unstage only the unexpected path and inspect again. Do not reset or rewrite the attempt.
actions.evidence: The staged list is a local scope check, not proof that a refactor is behaviorally equivalent.

actions.title: Commit the accepted refactor boundary
actions.instruction: After the learner reviews the staged future private boundary, invoke the host-native commit gate. It is a CodeArbiter command, never a ! terminal passthrough command.
actions.rationale: The future Check expects the refactor commit before the docs-only commit.
actions.expected_result: A future private attempt has one committed refactor boundary before the later docs-only work.
actions.recovery: If the gate reports a finding, preserve it and correct only the stated boundary. Do not amend or rewrite the attempt history.
actions.evidence: A commit can show ordered paths and bytes. It does not prove a human approval or a successful host conversation.

actions.title: Start the host-native docs chore route
actions.instruction: Only in a future private attempt, invoke the host-native docs chore route. Supply the exact approved README fact from the sealed brief when the host asks. This is a CodeArbiter command, never a ! terminal passthrough command.
actions.rationale: The second change is a docs-only boundary, not a disguised implementation change.
actions.expected_result: In a future private attempt, the host gathers the exact approved README fact before proposing a docs-only delta.
actions.recovery: If the host proposes code, test, or release-metadata changes, stop the chore boundary instead of staging it.
actions.evidence: This lesson does not treat the command text as proof of a valid docs-only decision.

actions.title: Inspect the proposed docs-only boundary
actions.instruction: Only in a future private attempt, inspect the proposed README delta in a native terminal. These commands are direct terminal commands and never begin with !.
actions.rationale: The learner can reject scope creep before the second commit exists.
actions.expected_result: You can inspect the future private README.md delta and identify any path outside the docs-only boundary.
actions.recovery: If any non-README.md path is present, stop and return to the sealed brief. Do not stage the chore.
actions.evidence: A worktree inspection reports local state only.

actions.title: Decide whether the docs-only boundary is acceptable
actions.instruction: In a future private attempt, decide whether the README.md delta states only the prepared approved fact. The learner makes this decision. Do not use a generated report as a substitute for it.
actions.rationale: A distinct review prevents the later docs commit from inheriting the refactor's authorization.
actions.expected_result: You either stop the docs boundary or can name README.md as the only file that may be staged.
actions.recovery: If the intended fact is not exact, preserve the diff and ask the agent to revise only that future draft.
actions.evidence: No artifact can prove that the learner accepted the docs-only boundary.

actions.title: Stage only the approved README change
actions.instruction: Only after accepting the future private docs-only boundary, stage README.md in a native terminal. Native-terminal commands never begin with !.
actions.rationale: The second staged path list keeps the chore distinct from the refactor commit.
actions.expected_result: The future private staged boundary names only README.md.
actions.recovery: If another path is staged, unstage only the unexpected path and inspect again. Do not reset or rewrite the attempt.
actions.evidence: The staged list can show an exact local path boundary, not an approval.

actions.title: Commit the accepted docs-only boundary
actions.instruction: After the learner reviews the staged future private README boundary, invoke the host-native commit gate. It is a CodeArbiter command, never a ! terminal passthrough command.
actions.rationale: The future Check expects the docs-only commit after the refactor commit.
actions.expected_result: A future private attempt has its docs-only commit after the sealed refactor commit.
actions.recovery: If the gate blocks, preserve the finding and correct only the named README boundary. Do not rewrite either commit.
actions.evidence: A commit can show ordered repository paths. It does not prove a human approval or a host command execution.

actions.title: Start the host-native release route
actions.instruction: Only in a future private attempt, invoke the host-native release route. Supply the exact declared target academy-private-training. It first presents the derived 0.0.1 patch release for learner confirmation; only after that confirmation may it write and commit CHANGELOG.md and compose an annotated local tag. This is a CodeArbiter command, never a ! terminal passthrough command. Do not invent a target and do not authorize a tag push or publication.
actions.rationale: The route is a local evidence step in this lesson, not a promise of published software.
actions.expected_result: After the learner confirms the derived version, the future private route commits the generated CHANGELOG.md section and composes annotated academy-v0.0.1 without a tag push or publication claim.
actions.recovery: If the target is absent or the route reports a blocker, preserve that result and stop. Do not manufacture release metadata.
actions.evidence: The local changelog commit and tag are observable release artifacts; they do not prove a remote tag, GitHub Release, or publication.

actions.title: Review the local tag boundary
actions.instruction: In a future private attempt, review the declared target and confirm that the required local release evidence is the generated CHANGELOG.md commit followed by annotated academy-v0.0.1 at the attempt head. Its body must reproduce the generated 0.0.1 changelog section followed by its matching Released-at date. Do not claim that a tag proves publication, a pushed reference, or a release record.
actions.rationale: The local tag has a narrow evidentiary meaning.
actions.expected_result: You can either stop for a missing boundary or proceed to inspect the declared local tag.
actions.recovery: If the tag name, object type, or target is not exact, preserve the state and stop. Do not retag over the attempt.
actions.evidence: Review is a learner action. The repository cannot prove it happened.

actions.title: Inspect the declared annotated tag at HEAD
actions.instruction: Only in a future private attempt, inspect academy-v0.0.1 and CHANGELOG.md in a native terminal. Confirm the tag is annotated at HEAD and that its body reproduces the generated 0.0.1 changelog section followed by a matching Released-at date. Native-terminal commands never begin with !.
actions.rationale: The learner verifies that the local tag is annotated, has Check's exact canonical body including one terminal newline, and points to the current attempt head.

variants.command:
git cat-file -t academy-v0.0.1
git tag --points-at HEAD
git show --no-patch --format=%B academy-v0.0.1
Get-Content CHANGELOG.md

git cat-file -t academy-v0.0.1
git tag --points-at HEAD
git show --no-patch --format=%B academy-v0.0.1
cat CHANGELOG.md

git cat-file -t academy-v0.0.1
git tag --points-at HEAD
git show --no-patch --format=%B academy-v0.0.1
cat CHANGELOG.md

actions.expected_result: The future private inspection reports a tag object, academy-v0.0.1 at HEAD, and a tag body whose generated release section exactly matches CHANGELOG.md before its matching Released-at date.
actions.recovery: If the object is lightweight, the tag is absent, its generated section or Released-at date differs from CHANGELOG.md, or it does not point at HEAD, stop the attempt without moving the tag.
actions.evidence: This local check does not prove a remote tag, a GitHub Release, or publication.

actions.title: Ask Preview 0.15 to check U03
actions.instruction: Run Check in a native terminal. Native-terminal commands never begin with !.
actions.rationale: The current refusal keeps incomplete private material out of the public course boundary.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.15 refuses U03 as unavailable or not published and leaves the repository unchanged.
actions.recovery: Keep the refusal as evidence of the public boundary. Do not imitate a passing U03 result.
actions.evidence: Preview 0.15 cannot attest to the future private U03 contract.

actions.title: Ask Preview 0.15 to reset U03
actions.instruction: Run Reset in a native terminal. Native-terminal commands never begin with !.
actions.rationale: The current refusal confirms that no U03 attempt exists to reset in Preview 0.15.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.15 refuses U03 as unavailable or not published and leaves the repository unchanged.
actions.recovery: Do not use Reset as a substitute for deleting or rewriting private attempt history. The current public release has none.
actions.evidence: Preview 0.15 creates no reset archive for an unavailable U03 lesson.
